decisions.selected: Per-step-type builder methods mirroring add_request_step/add_pause_step, plus a generic update_step and a reorder_steps action.
alternatives: A single generic add_step raw-dict passthrough action
decisions.rationale: The per-type builders mirror the existing add_request_step/add_pause_step pattern and give the LLM typed, self-documenting actions; a generic passthrough loses per-type affordance.

evidence.claim: The selected design adds per-step-type builders mirroring add_request_step/add_pause_step.
add_pause_step is the existing builder analog that POSTs a flat step_type body via api_request.

decisions.selected: Generic single-step update via PUT /steps/{step_id} (read-merge-PUT), reusing _put_step.
alternatives: Full test-steps PUT replace of the whole step list
decisions.rationale: The API offers a per-step PUT and the repo already has _put_step; full-list replace adds a race window and latency.

evidence.claim: update_step reads the current step, merges updates, and PUTs to /steps/{step_id}.
_put_step PUTs a full step dict to /steps/{step_id} via api_request.

decisions.selected: Reorder via PUT /steps with a caller-supplied template_order list.
decisions.rationale: The API's canonical reorder op is a full-list template_order PUT; per-step move actions only support adjacent swaps.

evidence.claim: reorder_steps PUTs a caller-supplied template_order list to /steps.

decisions.selected: Extend the TestStep model with inbound and subtest fields so responses round-trip without data loss.
alternatives: Extend TestStep with the missing inbound/subtest fields
Leave TestStep as-is and let Pydantic drop unknown response keys
decisions.rationale: Pydantic drops unknown keys by default, so without the model extension inbound/subtest response fields are silently lost.

evidence.claim: The TestStep model is extended with inbound and subtest fields to avoid dropping response data.
TestStep currently lacks inbound (token/isDynamicUrl) and several subtest fields, which Pydantic drops by default.

assumptions.claim: The radar input wire key for the conditional-if step is 'condition' (not 'conditional') and the parser auto-appends the end block, so the tool must not send an explicit end step.
assumptions.validation: test_add_condition_step asserts the body uses step_type 'condition' + condition_type 'start' with no explicit end block and that a start+end response round-trips.

evidence.claim: The radar input wire key for the conditional-if step is 'condition' (not 'conditional'); the parser auto-appends the end block.

assumptions.claim: The subtest step creation does not pre-validate test_uuid existence (lazy validation, matching the request-step precedent).
assumptions.validation: test_add_subtest_step asserts api_request is called exactly once as a POST with no pre-POST existence read.

evidence.claim: The subtest radar input requires test_uuid, trigger_token, environment_uuid, bucket_key, use_parent_environment; lazy validation matches the request-step precedent.

assumptions.claim: The tool reads no runtime/cache/db/queue data whose lifecycle could invalidate a read; update_step reads the live step immediately before PUT.
assumptions.validation: Runtime Data Availability Proof shows the only read (update_step) immediately precedes the PUT.

evidence.claim: The tool reads no runtime/cache/db/queue data whose lifecycle could invalidate a read.

interfaces.compatibility: Conformist — the api/tea-service owns the step contract and the tool adopts its radar-input shape as-is; no adapter needed on the request side.

evidence.claim: The radar input wire key for the conditional-if step is 'condition' (not 'conditional'); the parser auto-appends the end block.

interfaces.shape: List of step dicts; inbound/subtest responses carry token/isDynamicUrl and trigger_token/environment_id/use_parent_environment/params.
interfaces.compatibility: Adapter = TestStep model extension; without the added fields Pydantic drops them on round-trip.
